name: HELSMITHS OF HASHUT: URAK TAAR THE FIRST DAEMONSMITH
description: It is said that Urak Taar is ancient beyond measure, and studied how to shackle Chaos under Hashut himself. He has crafted more daemon engines than even he can recall, and was responsible for bringing the great Forge Anathema to the Bullfather’s worship. He ought to have been consumed by the stone-flesh curse long ago, but sheer will and arcane secrets have delayed this doom. He now seeks nothing less than to follow his master into godhood. Atop the bronze-bodied Taurus Ghorrakos, he wields the flames of ruin without fear, all while subjecting foes to a portion of his own dreadful curse.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds Urak Taar, mounted on his Infernal Taurus, Ghorrakos. As the first and greatest Daemonsmith, he is the ultimate leader for your Helsmiths of Hashut armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. Urak Taar is an absolute terror on the battlefield, lashing out with spells even while his mount grinds his foes into the earth under its metal hooves and gores them with long horns. Standing at 144mm tall with a wingspan of 193mm, this darkly majestic miniature towers over your army. As well as dominating on the tabletop, its stunning details, including stone-cursed flesh, runes, and gems, make for a true test of your painting skills. Taar can be assembled with or without ruinous torrents on his staff.</br></br>This miniature can alternatively be built as a Daemonsmith on Infernal Taurus, a cunning and twisted mounted sorcerer.</br></br>This kit comprises 76 plastic components and 1x Citadel 130mm Round Base. This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
